# NextGen Healthcare

> > NextGen Healthcare delivers integrated cloud-based EHR, practice management, and AI-powered solutions designed to streamline clinical workflows and revenue cycle operations for specialty practices of all sizes.

NextGen Healthcare provides comprehensive healthcare IT solutions spanning electronic health records, practice management, patient engagement, and revenue cycle management. The platform leverages AI technologies like Ambient Assist for clinical documentation and intelligent orchestration to optimize provider productivity and practice efficiency.

## Key Topics

- NextGen Healthcare
- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Practice Management (PM)
- Ambient Assist (AI Documentation)
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Medical Billing & Claims Processing
- Patient Engagement
- Healthcare Integration (Mirth Connect)
- Clinical Documentation
- ePrescribing
- Eligibility Verification
- NextGen Enterprise EHR
- NextGen Office
- Intelligent Orchestrator Agent

## Core EHR Solutions

- [NextGen Healthcare Homepage](https://www.nextgen.com): NextGen homepage featuring EHR, PM, and AI-powered solutions for practices.
- [Electronic Health Records Overview](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/electronic-health-records): NextGen EHR/EMR solutions tailored for ambulatory practices of all sizes.
- [Enterprise Electronic Health Records](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/electronic-health-records/mid-size-to-enterprise-practices): Enterprise EHR solution with AI orchestration and interoperability features.
- [Cloud-Based EHR for Small Practices](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/electronic-health-records/small-practices-nextgen-office): NextGen Office cloud EHR with Ambient Assist for small specialty practices.

## AI-Powered Provider Tools

- [Ambient Assist AI Documentation](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/provider-experience/ambient-assist): AI-powered Ambient Assist generating SOAP notes and clinical documentation.
- [NextGen Mobile App](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/provider-experience/mobile): NextGen Mobile app with AI charting, e-prescribing, and provider tools.

## Practice Management & Revenue Cycle

- [Practice Management Overview](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management): NextGen practice management software for workflows and patient management.
- [Medical Billing Solutions](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/billing): Integrated medical billing system for clean claims and revenue cycle.
- [Revenue Cycle Management with Waystar](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/clearinghouse-edi): Revenue cycle management with Waystar clearinghouse and EDI integration.
- [Charge Review Rules Engine](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/rules-engine): Charge review rules engine automating billing and revenue capture.
- [Medical Claims Coding](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/coding): Specialty-based medical coding services for clean claims and collections.
- [Collections & A/R Management](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/collections): Collections and A/R management integrated with practice management.
- [Registration & Scheduling](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/practice-management/registration-scheduling): Registration and scheduling services optimizing practice revenue cycle.

## Patient Engagement & Experience

- [Patient Care Access](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/patient-experience/patient-care-access): Patient self-scheduling, waitlist, and reputation management automations.
- [Patient Intake](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/patient-experience/patient-intake): Digital patient intake with eligibility verification and payment collection.

## Healthcare Integration

- [Healthcare Integration Engine - Mirth Connect](https://www.nextgen.com/solutions/interoperability/mirth-integration-engine): Mirth Connect healthcare integration engine enabling seamless data exchange.
